items.title: 日銀審議委員高田創釋鷹派訊號 暗示加速升息步伐
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Board Member Takada Signals Hawkish Tone, Hinting at Accelerated Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行審議委員高田創周三(2日)在札幌召開的記者會上，釋出強烈鷹派訊號。他表示，未來的升息幅度不排除超過常規的0.25%，且連續升息也是可能的選項，顯示日銀可能加速貨幣緊縮步伐。
日銀過去三次升息均以0.25%的幅度進行，且間隔約6個月，但高田創強調這並非一成不變。他指出，隨著日本經濟在2026年步入「機制轉變」的新階段，2%的物價穩定目標已基本實現，升息步伐將靈活且依賴數據，以因應國內外的價格與經濟風險。
在先前的7月會議中，高田曾投下唯一的反對票，倡議直接升息25個基點至1.25%。
高田創的發言讓市場對日銀在9月18日政策會議上升息的預期顯著升溫，日元匯率隨之走強，一度回升至1美元兌159.80日元附近。日銀總裁植田和男此前暗示，將在考慮上行價格風險的前提下做出決策，增添了本月升息的可能性。
與此同時，受到首相高市早苗擴張性財政政策預期及日銀減少購債影響，日本10年期公債殖利率30年來首度突破3%。高田對此強調，日銀減少購債旨在維護市場穩定並避免過度波動，而非迎合國家的財政狀況。
摩根大通分析師指出，高田的言論反映了日銀內部的整體鷹派轉變，預計日銀將於9月與12月分別升息25個基點。
paras_en: On Wednesday (2nd), Bank of Japan board member Takada Saku gave a strongly hawkish signal at a press conference in Sapporo, stating that future rate hikes could exceed the conventional 0.25% and that consecutive hikes are also a possibility, indicating that the BOJ may accelerate its monetary tightening pace.

The BOJ has previously raised rates three times by 0.25% each, roughly every six months, but Takada emphasized that this is not set in stone. He noted that as Japan’s economy enters a new “mechanism shift” phase in 2026, the 2% inflation target is essentially achieved, and the pace of hikes will be flexible and data‑dependent to respond to domestic and global price and economic risks.
During the July meeting, Takada cast the sole dissenting vote, advocating a direct 25‑basis‑point hike to 1.25%.

Takada’s remarks stoked market expectations of a rate hike at the September 18 policy meeting, strengthening the yen as it briefly rebounded to around 159.80 yen per dollar. BOJ Governor Ueda had previously hinted that a decision would be made considering upward price risks, adding to the likelihood of a hike this month.

Meanwhile, amid expectations of Prime Minister Fumio Kishida’s expansionary fiscal policy and the BOJ’s reduced bond purchases, the yield on Japan’s 10‑year government bonds broke 3% for the first time in 30 years. Takada stressed that the BOJ’s bond‑purchase cuts aim to maintain market stability and avoid excessive volatility, not to accommodate the country’s fiscal situation.
Morgan Stanley analysts noted that Takada’s comments reflect a broader hawkish shift within the BOJ, forecasting 25‑basis‑point hikes in both September and December.

items.title: 億萬富翁泰珀AI布局大轉向：棄短期獲利擁抱長期前景
items.title_en: Billionaire Tepper Shifts AI Strategy: Abandons Short-Term Gains for Long-Term Outlook
paras: 華爾街億萬富翁泰珀(David Tepper)旗下的 Appaloosa Management ，第二季進行引人注目的資金輪替，完全清空了僅持有一季的半導體熱門股 SanDisk(SNDK-US)，並首度建立博通(AVGO-US)的部位。
這項操作並不代表泰珀看淡人工智慧(AI)的前景，而是顯示出他在 AI 基礎建設投資上的策略性轉變——從受惠於價格暴漲的儲存設備，轉向更具持久性的客製化晶片與網路架構。

SanDisk獲利了結

SanDisk 近期的財務數據極為亮眼，第四季營收季增 51%、年增 372% 至 89.7 億美元，單季淨利高達 69 億美元，毛利率攀升至 84.6%。 其 2026 會計年度全年營收更達 202.5 億美元(年增 175%)，年度淨利達 114.3 億美元，較前一年的虧損大幅扭轉。
然而，這波爆發有高達三分之二的季成長是來自「價格上漲」，僅有三分之一來自「出貨量成長」。 記憶體市場歷史上具有高度的景氣循環特性，泰珀顯然選擇在供需平衡被打破、價格見頂前先行獲利了結。

布局博通在超大型資料中心的持久優勢

相較之下，博通提供的是專用 AI 加速器與高速網路設備，用以連結大規模計算集群，這使其深入超大型資料中心的長期規劃，較不易受到記憶體價格波動的影響。
博通第二季 AI 半導體銷售額已達 108 億美元(年增 143%)，約為 SanDisk 季度資料中心營收的四倍，且預期第三季將攀升至 160 億美元。

AI 投資新階段的框架啟示

儘管減持了 SanDisk(此前持股價值約 1.787 億美元)，泰珀對 AI 的整體布局依然龐大，旗下前兩大持股分別為亞馬遜(AMZN-US)(1.19 億美元)與美光(MU-US)(1.13 億美元)，並持續重倉台積電(TSM-US)(7.88 億美元)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(6.54 億美元)、Meta(META-US)(3.8 億美元)及輝達(NVDA-US)(3.05 億美元)。
這次博通的 5,670 萬美元新部位(15 萬股)規模相對較小，但顯露其戰略指標。
paras_en: Wall Street billionaire David Tepper’s Appaloosa Management made a striking portfolio rotation in the second quarter, completely exiting the semiconductor hot‑stock SanDisk (SNDK‑US) that it had held for only one quarter and establishing a position in Broadcom (AVGO‑US) for the first time.

This move does not signal Tepper’s lack of confidence in artificial‑intelligence (AI) prospects; rather, it reflects a strategic shift in his AI‑infrastructure investments—from storage devices that have surged in price to more durable custom chips and networking architectures.

SanDisk’s profit‑taking
SanDisk’s recent financials were dazzling, with fourth‑quarter revenue up 51% sequentially and 372% year‑over‑year to $8.97 billion, quarterly net income soaring to $6.9 billion, and gross margin climbing to 84.6%. For the full 2026 fiscal year, revenue reached $20.25 billion (up 175% YoY) and net income hit $11.43 billion, a dramatic turnaround from the prior year’s loss.

However, about two‑thirds of this explosive growth came from price increases, with only one‑third driven by volume growth. Memory markets are historically highly cyclical, and Tepper clearly chose to lock in profits before the supply‑demand balance broke and prices peaked.

Broadcom’s durable advantage in hyperscale data centers
In contrast, Broadcom supplies dedicated AI accelerators and high‑speed networking gear that connect massive compute clusters, embedding it in the long‑term plans of hyperscale data centers and making it less vulnerable to memory‑price swings.

Broadcom’s AI semiconductor sales hit $10.8 billion in the second quarter (up 143% YoY), roughly four times SanDisk’s quarterly data‑center revenue, and are expected to climb to $16 billion in the third quarter.

Framework of the new AI‑investment phase
Even after trimming its SanDisk stake (previously worth about $178.7 million), Tepper’s overall AI exposure remains massive, with the firm’s top two holdings being Amazon (AMZN‑US) at $119 million and Micron (MU‑US) at $113 million, while still holding large positions in TSMC (TSM‑US) at $788 million, Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) at $654 million, Meta (META‑US) at $380 million, and Nvidia (NVDA‑US) at $305 million.
The new Broadcom position—$56.7 million for 150,000 shares—is relatively modest in size but reveals a strategic signal.

items.title: 〈SEMICON〉侯永清：AI需求短短半年就翻倍 供應鏈合作必須重構
items.title_en: SEMICON: Hou Yongqing – AI Demand Doubles in Six Months, Supply Chain Collaboration Must Be Reconstructed
paras: AI需求持續高速成長，半導體供應鏈面臨前所未見的擴產壓力。台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US)資深副總經理暨副共同營運長侯永清今(2)日表示，AI需求不只是規模龐大，更大的挑戰在於需求變化速度遠超過去產業經驗，以台積電設備需求為例，去年底預估今年所需設備量若以1倍計算，僅一季後就提高至1.5倍，至今年7月更已達1.9倍，等同短短半年需求接近翻倍，整個半導體生態系都必須重新思考如何因應。
侯永清今日與日月光投控(3711-TW)(ASX-US)執行長吳田玉、聯發科(2454-TW)副董暨執行長蔡力行、鴻海(2317-TW)董事長劉揚偉、欣興(3037-TW)董事長簡山傑於大師論壇進行對談。
侯永清指出，過去30年半導體產業從未面臨如此快速的需求變化，現在最大的問題已不只是有沒有需求，而是整體產業能否在極短時間內，提供接近原先2倍的設備、產能與相關資源。
他坦言，AI對運算能力與能源效率的需求持續提升，不只先進製程必須加速演進，先進封裝與整體系統效能的要求也同步快速提高。相較過去半導體產業可以依照既有生產流程，由一家廠商完成自身環節後，再交給下一階段業者，未來這種「接棒式」合作方式恐怕已無法滿足AI需求。
他進一步指出，AI時代追求的不再只是單一元件或單一製程效能，而是整個系統或模組的最佳化，因此每一個環節都必須確保自身性能能夠在下一階段被真正實現，包括後續製程、封裝、測試、製程窗口與良率等，都必須更緊密整合，「這需要一種全新的合作模式」，也是過去產業較少出現的協作方式。
面對需求急速升溫，侯永清透露，台積電目前已以前所未有的速度擴充產能。光是在台灣，目前就同步興建13座晶圓廠，海外另有約5至6座廠同步推進，全球合計接近20座，相較過去同一時間大約只能進行4至5座廠，目前建廠規模已放大至過去約3至4倍。
不過，即使如此快速擴張，仍然無法完全滿足客戶需求。侯永清坦言，台積電正在努力追趕市場需求，台灣整體半導體生態系也都在加倍投入，加速產能建置，但客戶仍認為供給提升的速度不夠快。
侯永清認為，這波AI擴產潮並非台積電一家公司的問題，而是整個產業生態系都必須同步放大。吳田玉也形容，當半導體產業建立起一座龐大的「金字塔」，不能只讓最上層晶圓製造快速成長，包括無塵室、設備、測試、維修、材料以及工程服務等底層供應鏈，都必須按照相近速度同步擴充。
侯永清回應，真正的挑戰就在於「整個生態系尚未準備好」如此快速的成長。無論台積電希望在台灣、美國亞利桑那州或其他地區進一步擴產，都會碰到當地工程、水資源及基礎建設等不同限制；而當設備需求在半年內接近翻倍，也幾乎沒有任何一家供應商能完全避開產能限制。
因此，他強調，目前的供應問題不能再被視為單一公司或單一產業環節的問題，而是整條半導體供應鏈共同面對的挑戰。台灣目前掌握全球重要的半導體製造、封裝與測試能力，也因此有責任投入更多資源，協助解決AI快速成長所帶來的產能與技術瓶頸。
除擴充硬體產能外，侯永清也指出，台灣半導體產業不論大型企業、中小型業者甚至新創公司，目前都持續加碼研發，希望加快技術推進速度，以支援AI產業需求。換言之，產業下一階段競爭不只是誰能蓋更多廠，而是誰能同時在產能、技術與供應鏈協作效率上加速。
值得注意的是，侯永清也認為AI本身可以成為解決產能瓶頸的工具。透過AI加速數位化與生產流程最佳化，即使既有實體產能沒有等幅增加，也有機會提升生產效率與既有資產產出，讓企業利用相同產能創造更多產值。
不過，他也提醒，AI是一把「雙面刃」，企業一方面希望利用AI提升生產力，另一方面也必須思考多年累積的製程經驗與技術know-how該如何受到保護。若智慧財產與企業知識保護問題無法解決，反而可能拖慢企業導入AI的腳步。
侯永清進一步指出，未來AI導入製造業，也不能只是沿用傳統流程，再挑選其中某一個環節以AI取代，而是應該重新思考，在AI時代下，既有流程是否還有必要存在，甚至可能需要從根本重新設計整套生產模式。
吳田玉最後則總結，台灣短期仍將利用既有完整半導體生態系，盡最大努力支援全球AI需求，但隨著AI市場持續擴大，加上地緣政治與供應鏈韌性的重要性提升，長期仍需要與海外共同建立新的產業生態系，而生成式AI若能加速知識傳承，也有望降低台灣半導體製造經驗向海外複製的難度。
paras_en: AI demand is growing at an unprecedented pace, putting the semiconductor supply chain under extreme expansion pressure. Senior Vice President and Deputy COO of TSMC, Hou Yongqing, said today that AI demand is not only massive in scale but also changes at a speed far beyond past industry experience. For example, TSMC’s equipment needs were estimated at a 1× level at the end of last year; by the end of the first quarter, that figure rose to 1.5×, and by July it reached 1.9×—nearly doubling in just six months, forcing the entire semiconductor ecosystem to rethink its response.
Hou Yongqing spoke with executives from ASE (Wu Tianyu), MediaTek (Cai Lixing), Foxconn (Liu Yangwei), and Xinxing (Jian Shanjie) at the Da Shi Forum.

He pointed out that in the past 30 years the semiconductor industry has never faced such rapid demand changes. The biggest issue now is not whether demand exists, but whether the industry can deliver roughly twice the equipment, capacity, and resources in an extremely short time.

He admitted that AI’s demand for computing power and energy efficiency continues to rise, requiring not only faster advanced process evolution but also rapid improvements in advanced packaging and overall system performance. Unlike the past, where a single vendor could complete its own stage and hand it off to the next, the “handoff” model may no longer satisfy AI needs.

He further explained that the AI era seeks optimization of entire systems or modules, not just single components or processes. Every link must ensure its performance can be realized in the next stage, including subsequent processes, packaging, testing, process windows, and yield. These must be more tightly integrated, requiring a brand‑new collaboration model rarely seen before.

Facing the rapid rise in demand, Hou revealed that TSMC is expanding capacity at an unprecedented speed. In Taiwan alone, 13 new fabs are being built simultaneously, with another 5–6 overseas, bringing the global total to nearly 20—about three to four times the scale of past expansions of 4–5 fabs at the same time.

Despite this rapid expansion, it still cannot fully meet customer demand. Hou admitted that TSMC is working hard to catch up with market needs, and the entire Taiwanese semiconductor ecosystem is doubling investment and accelerating capacity build‑out, yet customers still feel the supply increase is too slow.

He believes this AI expansion wave is not a problem of a single company but of the entire industry ecosystem. Wu Tianyu described the semiconductor industry as a massive “pyramid” that cannot let only the top layer of wafer manufacturing grow rapidly; the lower‑level supply chain—clean rooms, equipment, testing, maintenance, materials, and engineering services—must also expand at a comparable pace.

Hou responded that the real challenge is that the entire ecosystem is not ready for such rapid growth. Whether TSMC expands in Taiwan, Arizona, or elsewhere, it will face local engineering, water resources, and infrastructure constraints; with equipment demand nearly doubling in six months, almost no supplier can fully avoid capacity limits.

Therefore, he emphasized that the current supply issue cannot be seen as a problem of a single company or a single industry segment, but a challenge faced by the entire semiconductor supply chain. Taiwan currently holds key global manufacturing, packaging, and testing capabilities, and thus has a responsibility to invest more resources to help overcome the capacity and technology bottlenecks brought by AI’s rapid growth.

Beyond expanding hardware capacity, Hou also noted that the Taiwanese semiconductor industry—whether large enterprises, SMEs, or startups—is continuously ramping up R&D to accelerate technology progress and support AI industry demand. In other words, the next stage of competition is not just about building more fabs, but about accelerating capacity, technology, and supply‑chain collaboration efficiency.

It is noteworthy that Hou also believes AI itself can become a tool to solve capacity bottlenecks. By accelerating digitization and production process optimization, even if existing physical capacity does not increase proportionally, there is an opportunity to improve production efficiency and asset output, allowing companies to create more value with the same capacity.

However, he cautioned that AI is a double‑edged sword. While companies want to use AI to boost productivity, they must also consider how to protect the accumulated process experience and technical know‑how. If intellectual property and corporate knowledge protection cannot be solved, it may actually slow the adoption of AI.

Hou further pointed out that future AI adoption in manufacturing cannot simply reuse traditional processes and replace a single link with AI. Instead, it should rethink whether existing processes are still necessary in the AI era and may even require a fundamental redesign of the entire production model.

Finally, Wu Tianyu concluded that Taiwan will continue to leverage its complete semiconductor ecosystem in the short term to support global AI demand. As the AI market expands, geopolitical and supply‑chain resilience become more important, and in the long term Taiwan will need to build new industry ecosystems with overseas partners. Generative AI, if it can accelerate knowledge transfer, may reduce the difficulty of replicating Taiwan’s semiconductor manufacturing experience abroad.

items.title: AI PCB供需持續吃緊深南電路封裝載板營收翻倍、上半年資本支出年增255.3%
items.title_en: AI PCB Supply Remains Tight as Shennan Circuit’s Packaging Substrate Revenue Doubles and H1 Capital Expenditure Rises 255.3% YoY
paras: 2026年09月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心需求持續向PCB與IC載板供應鏈擴散，深南電路(002916-CN)2026年上半年資料中心相關訂單收入已突破人民幣20億元，帶動PCB營收達人民幣85.52億元，年增率36.32%；IC載板成長更為強勁，營收達人民幣36.67億元，年增率110.76%，成為目前公司獲利彈性最大的業務。
更值得注意的是毛利率變化。2026年上半年IC載板毛利率升至31.35%，較去年同期大幅提高16.20個百分點，反映AI帶動記憶體、電源管理與先進運算需求後，高產能利用率與產品組合升級已開始轉化為獲利。BT載板受惠AI推升記憶體需求，FC-BGA載板高階產品則已在多個客戶實現規模量產，帶動廣州廠產能加速爬坡。
需求快速增加也讓深南電路加快擴產。公司2026年上半年投資總額達人民幣39.61億元，年增率255.3%。其中，廣州IC載板廠累計投入人民幣47.76億元，建置進度達77.74%；無錫AI運算用PCB廠累計投入人民幣9.62億元，建置進度22.48%，顯示公司正進入新一輪AI相關產能擴張週期。
從產業面來看，供應吃緊也不只出現在IC載板。目前mSAP產能仍處於短缺，上游AI用銅箔基板供應同樣偏緊，公司管理層現階段更關注原料能否穩定取得，而非單純的成本壓力，銅箔基板漲價也能順利轉嫁至新訂單。隨著1.6T光收發模組滲透率提升，mSAP、高階AI PCB與IC載板正同步進入新一輪擴產週期。

paras_en: On September 2, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – AI data‑center demand continues to spread through the PCB and IC substrate supply chain. Shennan Circuit (002916‑CN) recorded data‑center‑related order revenue of over RMB 2 billion in the first half of 2026, driving PCB revenue to RMB 8.552 billion, a year‑over‑year increase of 36.32%. IC substrate revenue grew even faster, reaching RMB 3.667 billion, up 110.76% YoY, making it the company’s most profit‑flexible business today.

A particularly noteworthy development is the change in gross margin. In the first half of 2026, the gross margin for IC substrates rose to 31.35%, a sharp increase of 16.20 percentage points from the same period last year. This reflects that AI‑driven demand for memory, power‑management and advanced computing has pushed capacity utilization and product‑mix upgrades to start translating into profit. BT substrates benefited from AI‑driven memory demand, while high‑end FC‑BGA substrates have entered mass production with multiple customers, accelerating the ramp‑up of the Guangzhou plant’s capacity.

The rapid surge in demand has also prompted Shennan Circuit to accelerate capacity expansion. The company’s total investment in the first half of 2026 reached RMB 3.961 billion, a year‑over‑year rise of 255.3%. Of this, the Guangzhou IC substrate plant has accumulated RMB 4.776 billion in spending, with construction progress at 77.74%; the Wuxi AI‑computing PCB plant has accumulated RMB 962 million, with progress at 22.48%, indicating the firm is entering a new cycle of AI‑related capacity expansion.

From an industry perspective, tight supply is not limited to IC substrates. mSAP capacity remains scarce, and upstream copper‑foil substrate supply for AI is also constrained. Management is currently more focused on securing stable raw‑material supplies rather than pure cost pressure, and the price increase for copper‑foil substrates can be smoothly passed on to new orders. As the penetration of 1.6 T optical transceiver modules rises, mSAP, high‑end AI PCBs and IC substrates are all entering a new round of capacity expansion.

items.title: Palo Alto財報速讀｜AI資安需求持續升溫營收34.1億美元、2027財年財測優於預期
items.title_en: Palo Alto Earnings Snapshot: AI Security Demand Keeps Rising, Revenue $3.41 B, FY2027 Outlook Beats Expectations
paras: 2026年09月02日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 資安大廠帕羅奧圖網路Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)公布第二季財報，調整後每股盈餘1.02美元，高於市場預期0.98美元；營收34.1億美元，年增率34%，也優於預期33.5億美元，訂單餘額與軟體年度經常性收入(ARR)同樣優於市場預期。
營收成長主要受CyberArk與Chronosphere兩筆併購挹注，公司對下一財季及2027財年的財測也高於市場預期。執行長Nikesh Arora表示，AI對資安產業是長期順風，隨企業導入AI代理程式，新的攻擊面同步增加，企業需要更完整的資安平台管理代理式AI行為與自動化威脅。
這項趨勢也呼應CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)近期財報所反映的產業方向：AI不只提高企業生產力，也讓網路攻擊能以更快速度、更大規模自動化執行，使資安支出需求進一步提升。
不過，強勁財報未能立即推升股價。Palo Alto週三早盤下跌1.7%，此前週二已下跌5.2%，市場出現獲利了結。該股自今年2月低點已反彈159%，目前本益比約為2027財年每股盈餘財測中值的87倍，顯示AI資安成長預期已部分反映在估值。

paras_en: September 2, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Cybersecurity giant Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) released its Q2 results, posting adjusted earnings of $1.02 per share, above the market forecast of $0.98. Revenue came in at $3.41 billion, a 34% year‑over‑year increase and higher than the expected $3.35 billion, with order backlog and software annual recurring revenue (ARR) also beating estimates.

Revenue growth was driven mainly by the CyberArk and Chronosphere acquisitions, and the company’s guidance for the next quarter and FY2027 also exceeds market expectations. CEO Nikesh Arora said AI is a long‑term tailwind for the security industry; as enterprises adopt AI agents, new attack surfaces expand, and companies need more comprehensive security platforms to manage agent‑based AI behavior and automated threats.

This trend mirrors the industry direction reflected in CrowdStrike’s (CRWD-US) recent earnings: AI not only boosts corporate productivity but also enables cyber‑attacks to be executed faster and at larger scale through automation, further driving security‑spending demand.

However, the strong earnings did not immediately lift the stock. Palo Alto fell 1.7% in early trade on Wednesday after a 5.2% drop on Tuesday, as investors took profits. The shares have rebounded 159% from their February low this year and now trade at roughly 87 times the median FY2027 earnings estimate, indicating that AI‑security growth expectations are already partially priced in.

items.title: AI搶應屆生飯碗！達拉斯聯準銀行：德州高暴露職位招聘降8% 藍領缺逆勢增
items.title_en: AI Snags Fresh Graduates’ Jobs! Dallas Fed: Texas AI-High Exposure Hiring Down 8%, Blue‑Collar Demand Rising
paras: 美國達拉斯聯準銀行周二(1日)發表最新研究報告指出，自2022年ChatGPT問世以來，德州「AI高暴露職位」招聘持續走弱，應屆大學畢業生失業率衝上「異常高位」，成為生成式AI就業衝擊的最先承壓族群。
達拉斯聯準銀行研究員Samuel Dodini 與 Tucker Smith在報告中寫道：「這些動態表明，應屆大學畢業生失業率在生成式AI快速普及期間升至異常高位，正是生成式AI對就業和收入影響最先顯現的群體。」
報告指出，德州是全美資料中心在建容量最大州，但藍領(電力工程師、建築工人)隨著AI基建擴張，白領卻未同步受益。AI高暴露職業集中在軟體開發、網頁設計、電腦密集崗，以及管理、文職、編輯等畢業生傳統入口，AI工具直接取代部分初級產出，資料中心本身不創造軟體工程師職缺。
民意與政治隨之擺動。根據賓州大學去年7月調查， 61%美國成人反對在居住地建資料中心，較2–3月調查時上升12個百分點。
另據國際勞工組織(ILO)發表的《2026 全球青年就業趨勢》，2025年全球青年失業率12.4%(約6700 萬人)，北美地區從2023年 8.3%升至9.8%，西歐地區高達15%。
ILO就業、技能與永續企業部門主任Sukti Dasgupta表示，AI直接影響尚不明朗，「科技必須為年輕人服務，而不是與他們為敵」。
paras_en: The Dallas Federal Reserve released a new research report on Tuesday (Jan. 1) noting that since the launch of ChatGPT in 2022, hiring for AI‑high exposure roles in Texas has continued to weaken, pushing the unemployment rate for recent college graduates to an unusually high level and making them the first group to feel the employment shock from generative AI.

In the report, Dallas Fed researchers Samuel Dodini and Tucker Smith wrote, "These dynamics show that the unemployment rate for recent college graduates rose to an unusually high level during the rapid proliferation of generative AI, and this group is the first to experience the impact of generative AI on employment and income."

The report points out that Texas has the largest planned data‑center capacity in the U.S., yet blue‑collar workers (power engineers, construction workers) are benefiting from AI infrastructure expansion while white‑collar workers are not keeping pace. AI‑high exposure occupations are concentrated in software development, web design, computer‑intensive jobs, and traditional entry points such as management, clerical, and editorial roles for graduates. AI tools directly replace some entry‑level output, and data centers themselves do not create software engineering positions.

Public opinion and politics have shifted accordingly. According to a July survey by Penn State University, 61% of U.S. adults oppose building data centers in their communities, up 12 percentage points from the February‑March survey.

According to the International Labour Organization’s (ILO) publication "Global Youth Employment Trends 2026," the global youth unemployment rate in 2025 is 12.4% (about 67 million people). In North America, it rose from 8.3% in 2023 to 9.8%, while Western Europe reached as high as 15%.

Sukti Dasgupta, director of the ILO’s Employment, Skills and Sustainable Enterprise Division, said the direct impact of AI is still unclear, adding, "Technology must serve young people, not be their enemy."

items.title: 日銀審議委員高田創釋鷹派訊號 暗示加速升息步伐
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Board Member Takada Signals Hawkish Tone, Hinting at Accelerated Rate Hikes
paras: 日本央行審議委員高田創周三(2日)在札幌召開的記者會上，釋出強烈鷹派訊號。他表示，未來的升息幅度不排除超過常規的0.25%，且連續升息也是可能的選項，顯示日銀可能加速貨幣緊縮步伐。
日銀過去三次升息均以0.25%的幅度進行，且間隔約6個月，但高田創強調這並非一成不變。他指出，隨著日本經濟在2026年步入「機制轉變」的新階段，2%的物價穩定目標已基本實現，升息步伐將靈活且依賴數據，以因應國內外的價格與經濟風險。
在先前的7月會議中，高田曾投下唯一的反對票，倡議直接升息25個基點至1.25%。
高田創的發言讓市場對日銀在9月18日政策會議上升息的預期顯著升溫，日元匯率隨之走強，一度回升至1美元兌159.80日元附近。日銀總裁植田和男此前暗示，將在考慮上行價格風險的前提下做出決策，增添了本月升息的可能性。
與此同時，受到首相高市早苗擴張性財政政策預期及日銀減少購債影響，日本10年期公債殖利率30年來首度突破3%。高田對此強調，日銀減少購債旨在維護市場穩定並避免過度波動，而非迎合國家的財政狀況。
摩根大通分析師指出，高田的言論反映了日銀內部的整體鷹派轉變，預計日銀將於9月與12月分別升息25個基點。
paras_en: On Wednesday (2nd), Bank of Japan board member Takada Saku gave a strongly hawkish signal at a press conference in Sapporo, stating that future rate hikes could exceed the conventional 0.25% and that consecutive hikes are also a possibility, indicating that the BOJ may accelerate its monetary tightening pace.

The BOJ has previously raised rates three times by 0.25% each, roughly every six months, but Takada emphasized that this is not set in stone. He noted that as Japan’s economy enters a new “mechanism shift” phase in 2026, the 2% inflation target is essentially achieved, and the pace of hikes will be flexible and data‑dependent to respond to domestic and global price and economic risks.
During the July meeting, Takada cast the sole dissenting vote, advocating a direct 25‑basis‑point hike to 1.25%.

Takada’s remarks stoked market expectations of a rate hike at the September 18 policy meeting, strengthening the yen as it briefly rebounded to around 159.80 yen per dollar. BOJ Governor Ueda had previously hinted that a decision would be made considering upward price risks, adding to the likelihood of a hike this month.

Meanwhile, amid expectations of Prime Minister Fumio Kishida’s expansionary fiscal policy and the BOJ’s reduced bond purchases, the yield on Japan’s 10‑year government bonds broke 3% for the first time in 30 years. Takada stressed that the BOJ’s bond‑purchase cuts aim to maintain market stability and avoid excessive volatility, not to accommodate the country’s fiscal situation.
Morgan Stanley analysts noted that Takada’s comments reflect a broader hawkish shift within the BOJ, forecasting 25‑basis‑point hikes in both September and December.

items.title: 紐西蘭央行再度升息1碼至2.75% 釋放鴿派緊縮訊號 紐元走跌
items.title_en: New Zealand Central Bank Raises Rates Again by 0.25% to 2.75%, Signalling Dovish Tightening; NZD Slides
paras: 紐西蘭央行周三(2日)宣布將基準利率上調25個基點(1碼)至2.75%。這是央行繼7月後連續第二次升息，旨在抑制高企的通膨。然而，央行透露未來緊縮路徑將比預期更為溫和，導致紐西蘭元應聲重挫達1%，兩年期公債殖利率下跌7個基點至3.58%。
交換合約數據顯示，市場預期10月升息的機率由之前的65%驟降至約36%。
紐西蘭第二季消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率達4.1%，主因是中東衝突推升燃料價格。不過，剔除車用燃料的核心通膨率已回落至2.7%至2.9%之間。央行預估，通膨將在2028年初回到2%的目標中位數。
針對未來利率政策，央行總裁 Anna Breman 指出，「基準利率很可能需要進一步調升」，但升息時機仍具高度不確定性，決策官員需綜合評估前兩次升息累積的效應與後續的經濟數據。
對此，Westpac 銀行紐西蘭首席經濟學家 Kelly Eckhold 分析，央行雖有升息決心，但目前看來，這比較像是12月而非10月和12月都會討論的議題。研調機構 Capital Economics 則認為，央行的訊息「比先前少了一些鷹派色彩」，並預測基準利率將在2027年上半年達到3.25%的峰值，低於市場預期的3.75%。
Kiwibank 首席經濟學家 Jarrod Kerr 表達了對此決策的讚許，並預期年底前僅會再升息一次至3.0%，隨後進入長期停頓。相對地，ASB 資深經濟學家 Mark Smith 則維持原有預估，認為10月及12月將各升息1碼，使年底基準利率達到3.25%的中性水準。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand announced on Wednesday (the 2nd) that it is raising the official cash rate by 25 basis points (one tick) to 2.75%. This is the second consecutive hike since July, aimed at curbing elevated inflation. However, the bank signaled that the future tightening path will be milder than expected, sending the New Zealand dollar down about 1% and pushing the two‑year government bond yield down 7 basis points to 3.58%.
Futures data show that the market’s probability of a rate hike in October fell sharply from about 65% to roughly 36%.

New Zealand’s consumer price index (CPI) for the second quarter rose 4.1% year‑on‑year, driven mainly by higher fuel prices due to the Middle East conflict. Core inflation, which excludes motor fuel, has eased to a range of 2.7%‑2.9%. The central bank projects that inflation will return to the 2% target midpoint in early 2028.

Regarding future policy, RBNZ Governor Anna Breman said the official cash rate is likely to need further increases, but the timing remains highly uncertain, with policymakers having to weigh the cumulative impact of the first two hikes against upcoming economic data.

Westpac New Zealand chief economist Kelly Eckhold noted that while the bank is determined to tighten, the next move looks more like a December issue rather than October, and Capital Economics argued the message is “somewhat less hawkish than before,” forecasting the cash rate to peak at 3.25% in the first half of 2027, below the market‑based expectation of 3.75%.

Kiwibank chief economist Jarrod Kerr praised the decision and expects only one more hike to 3.0% before year‑end, after which rates would stay on hold for a long period. In contrast, ASB senior economist Mark Smith sticks to his original view that both October and December will see 0.25‑point hikes, taking the year‑end cash rate to a neutral 3.25%.

items.title: 植田和男釋放9月升息強烈訊號！日銀升息預期近100%、日債殖利率飆近30年高
items.title_en: Ueda Kazuo Sends Strong September Rate‑Hike Signal! BoJ Rate‑Hike Expectation Near 100% and JGB Yields Surge to Near‑30‑Year High
paras: 日本銀行總裁植田和男釋出強烈升息訊號，市場對日銀9月再度調升政策利率的預期進一步升溫。植田日前出席美國北卡羅來納州阿什維爾舉行的G20財長與央行總裁會議後表示，日本目前貨幣環境仍相對寬鬆，因此日銀希望持續升息，並將在評估物價上行風險後討論貨幣政策。
植田指出，日銀迄今已累計5度調升政策利率，因此有必要審慎評估累積升息對經濟帶來的影響。下一次政策會議將進一步討論經濟情勢實現的可能性是否提高，以及通膨風險是否加劇。
這也是植田在9月17日至18日日銀政策會議前最後一次公開露面。根據《彭博》報導，隔夜指數交換（OIS）市場顯示，交易員對日銀9月升息的定價已接近100%，而植田此次談話也沒有反駁市場的升息預期。
與此同時，美國聯準會（Fed）鷹派官員也接連釋出強硬訊號。在華許（Kevin Warsh）警告通膨風險後，聯準會理事巴爾（Michael Barr）也表示，如果通膨未能充分降溫，聯準會就應果斷升息。

日銀升息預期升溫　日債殖利率創近30年新高

市場迅速反映日本貨幣政策可能進一步轉向緊縮的預期。10年期日本國債殖利率一度升至3.004%，30年期殖利率則觸及4.197%，雙雙創下近30年新高。
股市同樣承受壓力，日經225指數開盤下跌逾2.53%，報64678.49點，單日跌幅超過1700點；韓國KOSPI指數也同步下挫2.19%。
若日銀在9月18日宣布升息，將創下植田任內兩次升息間隔最短紀錄，打破過去約每6個月一次的貨幣政策正常化節奏。
植田表示，目前經濟數據大致符合日銀7月《展望報告》的預測，對於後續貨幣政策操作的基本思路也沒有重大改變。他同時指出，日本通膨趨勢已非常接近日銀設定的2%目標。
根據《彭博》調查，經濟學家預期日本關鍵價格指標可能在明年初回升至3%。
日銀政策委員會中立場最為鷹派的委員Hajime Takata也進一步強化升息預期。他在北海道札幌發表演說時重申7月主張連續升息的立場，並表示日本經濟已進入新階段，部分受到AI需求大增的影響，日本貨幣政策也不再是「異類」，需要靈活因應包括全球局勢在內的各項變化。

貝森特支持日銀升息　日元兌美元回到160上方

美國財政部表示，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）週日（30日）與植田和男會面時，強調制定及溝通健全貨幣政策的重要性，藉此穩定通膨預期並避免匯率出現過度波動。
貝森特也對日本為處理日元嚴重低估所採取的「果斷市場和貨幣措施」表達強烈支持，並表示預期植田會在貨幣政策上「做正確的事」，同時認為近期日元走勢「控制得相當好」。
不過，日元近期仍維持弱勢。截至東京時間週三（2日）上午，美元兌日元報160.37，日美兩國7月31日聯合干預匯市後，日元先前的升幅已大致回吐。

日本擴張財政遇上日銀緊縮　政策方向形成拉鋸

另一方面，日本政府各部門正提出規模創紀錄的下一會計年度預算申請，顯示首相高市早苗推動財政擴張的意向。
《彭博》報導指出，此次預算申請規模大幅增加，部分與會計方式調整有關。高市早苗希望終止日本長期在年度預算之外另行編列補充預算的做法。
日本財務大臣片山皋月（Satsuki Katayama）在G20會議後表示，與會各方並未對日本財政狀況表達擔憂。植田則認為，日本國債殖利率走高主要是「跟隨全球趨勢」。
在日本政府持續擴大財政支出的同時，日銀則逐步推進貨幣政策正常化。財政擴張與升息路徑之間的政策張力，正成為牽動日本債券、匯率與股市後續走勢的重要變數。
paras_en: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda issued a strong rate‑hike signal, heating up market expectations that the BOJ will raise its policy rate again in September. After attending the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting in Asheville, North Carolina, Ueda said Japan’s monetary environment remains relatively accommodative, so the BOJ wants to keep raising rates and will discuss policy after assessing inflation‑upside risks.

Ueda noted that the BOJ has already raised its policy rate five times in total, so it needs to carefully evaluate the cumulative impact of hikes on the economy. The next policy meeting will further examine whether the likelihood of achieving the desired economic conditions has risen and whether inflation risks have intensified.

This will be Ueda’s last public appearance before the BOJ policy meeting on September 17‑18. Bloomberg reported that the overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders pricing a September BOJ hike at almost 100%, and Ueda’s remarks did not contradict the market’s rate‑hike expectations.

At the same time, hawkish Fed officials have been issuing tough signals. After Kevin Warsh warned of inflation risks, Fed Governor Michael Barr said the Fed should act decisively on rate hikes if inflation does not cool sufficiently.

BOJ rate‑hike expectations rise as JGB yields hit near‑30‑year highs. The market quickly reflected expectations of a further tightening shift. The 10‑year Japanese government bond yield briefly rose to 3.004% and the 30‑year yield touched 4.197%, both setting near‑30‑year records.
Equities also felt the pressure, with the Nikkei 225 opening down more than 2.53% at 64,678.49 points, a single‑day drop of over 1,700 points; South Korea’s KOSPI fell 2.19% as well.
If the BOJ announces a hike on September 18, it would mark the shortest interval between two hikes under Ueda’s tenure, breaking the roughly six‑month normalisation rhythm previously observed.

Ueda said current economic data broadly match the BOJ’s July Outlook Report forecasts, and there is no major change to the basic approach for future policy actions. He also pointed out that Japan’s inflation trend is now very close to the BOJ’s 2% target.
A Bloomberg survey found economists expect Japan’s core price indicator could rebound to 3% early next year.

The most hawkish member of the BOJ Policy Board, Hajime Takata, further reinforced rate‑hike expectations. Speaking in Sapporo, Hokkaido, he reiterated his July stance for continued hikes and said Japan’s economy has entered a new phase, partly driven by a surge in AI demand, making monetary policy no longer an “outlier” and requiring flexible responses to global developments.

Bessent backs BOJ hikes; yen climbs back above 160 per dollar. The U.S. Treasury said Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Ueda on Sunday (the 30th) and stressed the importance of formulating and communicating sound monetary policy to stabilise inflation expectations and avoid excessive exchange‑rate volatility.

Bessent also voiced strong support for Japan’s “decisive market and monetary measures” to address the yen’s severe undervaluation, saying he expects Ueda to “do the right thing” on policy and noting that the yen’s recent move has been “well‑controlled.”

Nevertheless, the yen remains weak. As of Wednesday morning Tokyo time (the 2nd), the dollar was at 160.37 yen, and after the joint Japan‑U.S. intervention on July 31, the yen’s earlier gains have largely been erased.

Japan’s fiscal expansion meets BOJ tightening, creating a policy tug‑of‑war. Meanwhile, various Japanese ministries are submitting a record‑size budget request for the next fiscal year, signalling Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s push for fiscal expansion.

Bloomberg reported that the budget request’s massive increase is partly due to changes in accounting methods. Takaichi aims to end Japan’s long‑standing practice of preparing supplemental budgets outside the annual budget.

Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said after the G20 meeting that participants did not express concerns about Japan’s fiscal situation. Ueda believes the rise in JGB yields is mainly “following global trends.”

As the Japanese government continues to expand fiscal spending, the BOJ is gradually normalising monetary policy. The tension between fiscal expansion and the rate‑hike path is becoming a key factor shaping the future direction of Japanese bonds, the yen and equities.

items.title: 美債崩、日元潰！滙豐：當前亞洲金融環境與1997年危機前夕驚人相似
items.title_en: US Bond Collapse, Yen Plunge! HSBC: Current Asian Financial Environment Strikingly Similar to Pre‑1997 Crisis
paras: 滙豐首席經濟學家Frederick Neumann最新示警，當前亞洲金融環境與1997年危機前夕存在「驚人相似」：美債殖利率飆升、日元持續走弱、科技樂觀情緒瀰漫，三者格局幾乎相同。1997年亞洲金融危機曾讓泰銖、韓元崩盤，資本外逃、銀行倒閉潮席捲多國。
Neumann在最新研究報告中指出，目前美債10年期殖利率從2020年8月0.5%低潮攀至本週約4.79%，光是今年就自2月3.9%跳升80個基點，而反觀1993-1997年，同天期美債殖利率從5%衝至8%區域後在7%附近徘迴。
日元匯率方面，1995年4月美元兌日元匯率觸及80，1997年時貶至130，貶幅55%，而本輪自2021年1月103附近貶值57%至今年7月163，經美日罕見聯合干預才拉高至160，套利平倉隱憂未消。
此外，科技敘事亦很相像，當年網路狂熱，如今AI浪潮點燃南韓、日本、新加坡、台灣等出口榮景。
但Neumann強調，2026年與1997年「差異遠大於相似」，當時亞洲多為資本淨進口國、儲蓄不足，美元融資貴，加上日元狂貶直接引爆外債危機，如今亞洲轉成資本輸出方，外部融資擠壓不再致命，真正弱點是「需求脆弱性」，AI伺服器、HBM、先進封裝等硬體出口已經是成長支柱，若美債長端繼續上逼融資成本、或日元劇烈反轉擾亂全球流動性，外需一旦收縮，亞洲製造業景氣將快速失速。
機構普遍認為，系統性金融危機重演機率低，但「高成長高依賴」模式正進入壓力測試期。投資人宜區分區域套利結構與AI實質訂單，提防題材退潮及利率重估的雙殺。
paras_en: HSBC chief economist Frederick Neumann warned that today’s Asian financial environment bears "astonishing similarity" to the eve of the 1997 crisis: US Treasury yields are soaring, the yen keeps weakening, and tech optimism is pervasive, with the three elements forming almost the same pattern. The 1997 Asian financial crisis saw the Thai baht and South Korean won collapse, capital flight and a wave of bank failures sweeping many countries.

Neumann’s latest research notes that the 10‑year US Treasury yield has risen from a low of 0.5% in August 2020 to about 4.79% this week, jumping 80 basis points since February when it was 3.9%. By contrast, from 1993 to 1997 the same‑maturity yield rose from around 5% to the 8% area before hovering near 7%.

Regarding the yen, the USD/JPY rate hit 80 in April 1995, fell to 130 in 1997 – a 55% depreciation – and this cycle has seen it weaken from around 103 in January 2021 by 57% to 163 in July this year, only nudging up to 160 after a rare joint US‑Japan intervention, leaving arbitrage unwind risks still present.
The tech narrative is also similar: the internet frenzy of the 1990s mirrors today’s AI wave, fueling export booms in South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Taiwan and others.

Neumann stresses that the differences between 2026 and 1997 are far greater than the similarities. Back then most Asian economies were net capital importers with insufficient savings, expensive dollar financing and a sharply depreciating yen that sparked an external‑debt crisis. Today Asia is a net capital exporter, so external financing squeezes are less lethal; the real weakness is “demand fragility.” Hardware exports such as AI servers, HBM and advanced packaging have become growth pillars, but if long‑term US yields keep pushing financing costs up or the yen reverses sharply, disrupting global liquidity, a contraction in external demand could cause Asian manufacturing to stall rapidly.

Institutions generally see a low probability of a repeat systemic financial crisis, but the “high‑growth, high‑dependency” model is entering a stress‑test phase. Investors should differentiate regional arbitrage structures from genuine AI orders and guard against a double‑hit from theme fatigue and rate re‑pricing.

items.title: 人民幣升值衝擊！中國車廠上半年出海狂飆 但匯損逾78億吃掉一半利潤 吉利最慘
items.title_en: Renminbi Appreciation Shock! Chinese Automakers' Overseas Sales Soar in H1 but Exchange Losses Over 7.8 Billion RMB Ate Half Their Profit, Geely Hit the Hardest
paras: 今年上半年，中國汽車業交出慘淡成績單。根據Wind數據，289家汽車製造業上市公司歸母淨利565.31億元(人民幣，下同)，年減25.74%，整車製造利潤率跌至1.5%，創近十年新低，但比產業普跌更刺眼的是，出海越多，被匯率反噬越狠。
奇瑞匯兌淨損失20.92億元，吉利由去年同期26.4億元收益轉5.5億元損失，長城扣除鎖匯後仍損失2.66億元，長安淨損約2.3億元。比亞迪未單列匯兌項目，但財務費用淨支出50.96億元，不同於去年同期32.47億元淨收益，一進一出相差83.43 億元，相當於比亞迪當期歸母淨利123.25 億元的三分之二，浙商證券則計算其中約47億元為匯損。
比亞迪上半年營收3448.15億元，年減7.13%、歸母淨利123.25 億元，年減20.54%，看似雙降，但汽車業務毛利率從20.35%逆勢抬到22.33%，汽車收入持平 。推力來自於海外78.94萬輛銷量，年增67.9%、佔集團銷量44%，方程式豹/騰勢/仰望合計22.8 萬輛，年增61%、佔比升至12.8%。
根據東方證券計算，比亞迪海外汽車毛利率28.4%、國內僅17%，海外單車均價約16.3萬元，高於中國國內14.3萬元。
比亞迪上半年境外收入1812.68 億元，年增33.92%，佔總營收52.57%，史上首次超過中國國內，但出口量成長67.9%遠超收入成長33.92%，單車出口均價較一年前下降約1.6萬元，出口巴西19.47萬輛最多、東南亞、拉美等價格敏感市場比重亦上升，Dolphin MINI在巴西起售價約15萬元稀釋了整體平均售價。
根據中汽協數據，今年上半年比亞迪出口79.2 萬輛，次於奇瑞93.9萬輛，但汽車海外收入1294.97 億元是奇瑞989.68億元的 1.31 倍。
paras_en: In the first half of this year, China's auto industry posted a bleak performance. According to Wind data, the 289 listed auto manufacturers reported a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 56.531 billion, down 25.74% year‑on‑year, with the overall vehicle manufacturing profit margin falling to 1.5%, a near‑decade low. Even more striking than the industry‑wide decline is that the more they exported, the harsher the blow from exchange‑rate movements.

Chery suffered a net foreign‑exchange loss of RMB 2.092 billion, Geely swung from a RMB 2.64 billion gain in the same period last year to a RMB 5.5 billion loss, Great Wall still lost RMB 266 million after hedging, and Changan posted a net loss of about RMB 230 million. BYD did not list a separate FX item, but its net financial expense was RMB 5.096 billion, a reversal from a RMB 3.247 billion net gain a year earlier—a swing of RMB 8.343 billion, equivalent to two‑thirds of BYD’s net profit of RMB 12.325 billion for the period. Zhejiang Securities estimates that roughly RMB 4.7 billion of this amount was due to exchange losses.

BYD’s H1 revenue was RMB 344.815 billion, down 7.13% year‑on‑year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.325 billion, down 20.54%. While both figures fell, the automotive segment’s gross margin rose from 20.35% to 22.33% against the trend, and automotive revenue remained flat. The boost came from overseas sales of 789,400 vehicles, up 67.9% year‑on‑year and accounting for 44% of the group’s total sales. The Formula Leopard/Tengshi/Yaowang models together sold 228,000 units, up 61% and representing 12.8% of sales.

According to calculations by Dongfang Securities, BYD’s overseas vehicle gross margin was 28.4%, compared with only 17% domestically. The average price of an overseas BYD vehicle was about RMB 163,000, higher than the RMB 143,000 average price in China.

In the first half, BYD’s overseas revenue reached RMB 181.268 billion, up 33.92% year‑on‑year and accounting for 52.57% of total revenue – the first time overseas sales have exceeded domestic revenue. Export volume grew 67.9%, far outpacing revenue growth of 33.92%. The average export price per vehicle fell by roughly RMB 16,000 compared with a year earlier. Exports to Brazil topped 194,700 units, and the share of price‑sensitive markets such as Southeast Asia and Latin America also rose. The Dolphin MINI, priced at about RMB 150,000 in Brazil, diluted the overall average selling price.

Data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers show that BYD exported 792,000 vehicles in the first half of the year, second only to Chery’s 939,000 units, but BYD’s overseas revenue of RMB 129.497 billion was 1.31 times Chery’s RMB 98.968 billion.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】油價漲、美元強，日圓繼續走貶
paras: ◆USD/JPY

海灣地區再發生襲擊事件，引發全球債券拋售及加劇通貨膨脹憂慮，但美國新增就業崗位連續兩個月減少，市場不認為美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)有理由升息，為週五的就業數據作準備，而且美國財政部長貝森特加大對日本央行(BOJ)本月加息施壓，週二壓抑美元兌日圓；此外，日本財務省初步數據顯示第二季企業資本支出較去年同期增長1.6%較前季加快，提供BOJ近期加息理據，並據標準普爾(S&P)全球調查日本8月製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)終值升至4月以來最高54.9，更得益於半導體和人工智能(AI)相關產品需求強勁，新訂單增速創2018年1月以來最快，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月與美國財政部長貝森特會晤後稱，同意繼續協調以實現日圓匯率有序波動，推低美元兌日圓至159.62低點。

隨後美國公布7月建築支出意外較前月降0.5%至2023年10月以來最低，同時職位空缺與勞力流動調查(JOLTS)顯示，7月招聘數減少27.8萬，但職位空缺增至727.1萬個，表明勞動力市場平衡，並據美國供應管理協會(ISM)報告8月製造業PMI降至54.6，但投入價格居高不下，而且FED理事巴爾稱，若通貨膨脹未迅速降溫，FED應果斷加息，推升美元兌日圓至160.27高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於159.70-90，阻力於160.50-70。
◆EUR/USD

items.title: 里亞爾歷史新低 國內通膨66% 伊朗央行擬砸20億美元救匯市
items.title_en: Rial Hits Historic Low, Domestic Inflation at 66%, Iranian Central Bank Plans $2 B Injection to Stabilize Currency
paras: 里亞爾8月跌穿200萬里亞爾兌1美元歷史低點，7月國內通膨率升至66%。面對本幣貶值與物價失控的雙重壓力，伊朗央行準備向外匯市場注入20億美元，以平抑本幣劇烈波動。
伊朗央行總裁Abdolnaser Hemmati周二（1日）表示，德黑蘭擁有充足外匯存底，央行已準備向匯市注入20億美元，以平息近期里亞爾劇烈波動。
《路透社》指出，在伊朗總統Masoud Pezeshkian等官員近期多次提及國內經濟面臨的困境之後，總裁這番言論似乎意在安撫市場。
與央行救市並行的，是美國持續加碼經濟施壓。
美國財長貝森特警告，與伊朗做生意的國家可能面臨美國制裁，次級制裁「可能每周推出」，初期聚焦銀行，這場已持續半年的衝突正越來越多地透過制裁、封鎖與經濟壓力展開。
paras_en: The rial fell below 2 million per dollar in August, breaking its historical low, while domestic inflation rose to 66% in July. Facing dual pressures of currency depreciation and runaway prices, the Iranian central bank is ready to inject $2 billion into the foreign‑exchange market to curb the currency’s sharp swings.

Iranian Central Bank Governor Abdolnaser Hemmati said on Tuesday (1st) that Tehran has ample foreign‑exchange reserves and the bank is prepared to pour $2 billion into the market to calm recent volatility in the rial.
Reuters noted that after President Masoud Pezeshkian and other officials repeatedly highlighted the country’s economic difficulties, the governor’s remarks appear aimed at reassuring the market.
Alongside the central bank’s intervention, the United States continues to intensify economic pressure.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen warned that countries doing business with Iran could face U.S. sanctions, with secondary sanctions “potentially rolled out every week,” initially targeting banks. The six‑month‑old conflict is increasingly unfolding through sanctions, blockades, and economic pressure.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 美伊衝突升溫、債市遭拋售
paras: 美元周二(1日)走強，在油價飆升及債券市場遭拋售背景下，受到避險需求支撐。另一方面，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)敦促東京升息後，日元走弱，歐元則在通膨數據公布後下滑。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.69。
美國中央司令部(CENTCOM)周二表示，美軍已對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊(IRGC)目標發動攻擊，伊朗官媒則表示，攻擊擊中葛希姆島(Qeshm)一座工廠，以及霍爾木茲甘省(Hormozgan)的非軍事目標，美元因此受到避險買盤支撐。
在上周末之前，美國與伊朗一直因霍爾木茲海峽的控制權問題陷入僵局，而美國總統川普似乎已將策略從軍事打擊轉向經濟戰。
然而，周日軍事行動重新恢復。這是自7月以來首次恢復直接軍事行動。美國中央司令部表示，美軍對在霍爾木茲海峽布設水雷的伊朗革命衛隊部隊採取了「有限且精準的行動」。
伊朗隨後展開報復，對位於約旦的美軍基地發動攻擊。約旦官媒則另行報導，約旦成功攔截並摧毀8枚飛彈。
川普周二表示，最新一輪攻擊是為了回應伊朗布雷行動，以及對約旦軍事基地發動的攻擊。
油價周一已經上漲，周二在美軍發動新一輪攻擊後漲勢進一步擴大。11月到期的布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨最新上漲5.3%，至每桶95.25美元，10月到期的美國西德州中級原油期貨(WTI)突破每桶90美元，創6月11日以來首次。
Macquarie外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「相對而言，美元仍能從較高的原油價格中受益。當原油價格偏高時，美國的貿易條件改善、實質所得增加，貿易逆差也會縮小。過去的情況也顯示，即使原油供應受到不利衝擊，美元仍具一定的承受能力。」
債券遭拋售
周二美國公債殖利率及其他主要債市的拋售進一步加劇，市場對通膨與財政債務的擔憂升溫。美國10年期公債殖利率升至2023年11月以來最高水準，2年期公債殖利率也升至2024年7月以來最高。
自聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周五在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度經濟政策研討會發表偏鷹的主題演講後，市場對9月升息的預期大幅升溫。
本周市場原本聚焦通膨，但現在貨幣政策觀察人士也將注意力轉向美國勞動市場，希望從最新數據中尋找聯準會未來政策方向的更多線索。
周二公布的最新職位空缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)顯示，美國7月職缺數為727.1萬個，低於市場預期的733萬，但仍高於經下修後的6月718.2萬。
雖然7月職缺數低於預期，但職缺數較6月增加，而且整體水準仍接近4月創下的兩年高點758.5萬，顯示美國就業市場仍具韌性。
這讓聯準會在是否立即收緊貨幣政策方面獲得一些喘息空間，市場利率預期也反映了這點。
根據CME FedWatch工具，JOLTS數據公布後，市場預期聯準會9月升息1碼的機率約為68%，維持利率不變的機率則接近32%，兩者與前一日相比都沒有太大變化。
現在市場焦點已轉向周五公布的美國8月非農就業報告。

其他主要貨幣方面，歐元兌美元下跌0.3%，至1歐元兌1.1587美元。
歐盟統計局(Eurostat)稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區8月整體消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率加速至3.3%，明顯高於7月的2.9%。
不過，排除波動較大的能源、食品、酒類及菸草後的核心CPI，年增率意外從2.5%降至2.4%，服務通膨則放緩至3%。
日元兌美元走弱，美元兌日元上漲0.3%，至160.22。
160日元兌1美元是市場高度關注的關卡，過去曾觸發日本政府干預匯市，包括7月底日本與美國進行的一次歷史性聯合干預行動。
美國財政部長貝森特在G20財長會議期間，公開敦促日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)升息。
貝森特此舉被視為釋放「安倍經濟學」(Abenomics)時代結束的訊號。他並表示，自己掌握了一些市場目前並不知道、與日本穩定匯率措施有關的「資訊」。
換匯市場隨後提高對日本銀行9月升息的預期，目前升息機率接近88%。這項偏鷹的政策預期也推動日本10年期公債殖利率突破3%，創1996年8月以來首次。
